name: vanilla-deck
description: Twitter browser columns with isolated sessions.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-build.js && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json
scripts.package:win: npm run build && electron-packager . vanilla-deck --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=assets/icon.ico --out=out --overwrite --prune=true --asar "--ignore=%npm_package_config_packageWinIgnore%" && node scripts/harden-electron.js out/vanilla-deck-win32-x64/vanilla-deck.exe
scripts.check: biome check . && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
